verdict.rationale: smolagents has a documented multi-agent pattern: you create a manager agent and pass sub-agents through its `managed_agents` argument (e.g. `CodeAgent(tools=[], model=model, managed_agents=[web_agent])`), so several agents collaborate in one system. This directly covers the subagent form of orchestration. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-agent runs, and evidence beyond a single example page on peer-to-peer handoffs or how state is shared between agents.
